observations: White PlayStation 5 console with the 'PS5' logo on the front.
The console is shown from the front with the lid closed.
A black DualSense controller is resting on top of the console.
The background features posters for 'The First Descendant' and 'PC Engine'.
A fan is visible to the left of the console.
The console appears to be in a clean, domestic environment.

claims.evidence: The console is shown closed in a clean environment.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty optical drive.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The console may have a hardware fault such as a stuck disc or overheating issues.
risks.proof: A video of the console running a game and staying cool.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A screenshot of the console's 'System Information' screen showing the 'PSN Status'.

risks.risk: The console may be a counterfeit or clone.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Serial Number' sticker on the bottom of the console.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and navigating the home screen.
Video of the console playing a game to check the disc drive and temperature.
Screenshot of the 'System Information' screen showing the PSN status.
Photo of the 'Serial Number' sticker on the bottom of the console.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
